decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The shrub details submitted pursuant to conditions Condition 7 (Hard and Soft Landscaping), Condition 10 (landscape Management Plan) Condition 11 (Landscape Maintenance),  and Condition 8 (Landscaping details) of approved planning permission dated 06/06/2003 are considered not to be suitable for dry shade conditions and two of the tree species are unknown. The proposals are therefore not in accordance with Council policy ENV.B.1.1 (New Development) and of the London Borough Of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003.
description: Following approval for demolition of single storey toilet block, workshop and warehouse structures and erection of a 3 storey building incorporating 12 no. 1 bed flats and associated parking details submitted pursuant to Conditions 7 (hard and soft landscaping) and Condition 8 (landscaping details), Condition 10 (landscape management plan), Condition 11 (landscape maintenace), of approved planning permission 00707/AU/P7 dated 06/06/2003.
